note: Names, descriptions and grades are copied from the official list. Guides are written in my own words; anything not yet checked in-game is marked 'belum dicek di dalam game'.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Earn the other 54 trophies in this guide.
The platinum pops automatically once the last one lands — no extra task.
Use the roadmap tab to see which chapter still has trophies left.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end.
Follow the on-screen objectives — this is the game's first story mission.
It cannot be missed; it unlocks as the story opens.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1.
The chapter ends after its final mission — the trophy pops on the results screen.
Side activities in Chapter 1 can wait; the chapter trophy only needs the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2.
Watch for the chapter-closing mission — the trophy pops when it ends.
Do the chapter's partner missions before the finale; see the points of no return.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3.
The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission completes.
Clear any chapter-limited side jobs first — the missables page lists them.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4.
The trophy pops on the chapter's final mission.
This is the last chapter before the finale — finish open stranger strands now.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Play the final mission to the end.
It unlocks after Chapter 4 — follow the story marker.
The gold trophy pops on the mission results screen.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missable_note: Breakfast Run is a one-time story mission in Chapter 1 — finish it before the chapter ends.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Play the Breakfast Run mission in Chapter 1.
It is a single story mission — it only appears in its chapter window.
If you pass the chapter without it, use mission replay if the game offers it (belum dicek di dalam game).

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missable_note: The Cartel Heist is a one-time story mission in Chapter 2.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Play The Cartel Heist in Chapter 2.
Prepare before starting — heist missions are long and checkpointed.
The trophy pops when the heist mission ends.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missable_note: Child's Play is a one-time story mission in Chapter 3.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Play the Child's Play mission in Chapter 3.
It only appears in its chapter window — do it before the chapter finale.
The trophy pops on mission completion.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missable_note: Headliners is a one-time story mission in Chapter 2.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Play the Headliners mission in Chapter 2.
Do it before the Chapter 2 finale.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missable_note: VCIA Takedown is a one-time story mission in Chapter 3.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Play the VCIA Takedown mission in Chapter 3.
It is tied to the airport area — the exact trigger is belum dicek di dalam game.
The trophy pops on mission completion.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missable_note: Operation Savage Glory is a one-time story mission in Chapter 4.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Play Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 4.
Do it before the final mission.
The trophy pops when the operation ends.

trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Reach 100% completion in the in-game stats screen.
That means story, side missions, activities, collectibles and exploration together.
Use this guide's checklist — the last few percent are usually collectibles.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — count target 250
guide: Pull off stunts — jumps, near misses and air time all count.
Use the counter below to track your progress toward 250.
Stunts can be farmed anywhere in free roam, any time.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Try each activity type once — the official description says 9 types.
The exact list of 9 activity types is belum dicek di dalam game.
Sample one of each as you explore Leonida and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — count target 42
guide: Find a shooting range and open its challenge list.
Earn gold in all 42 challenges — retry any challenge until it is gold.
Use the counter below to track how many are gold so far.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — count target 14
guide: Find the Top Fun drone races — there are 14 locations.
Win one race at each location; the exact locations are belum dicek di dalam game.
Track each location with the counter below.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — count target 20
guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count twice.
Mix race types and locations to cover 20 distinct ones.
The counter below tracks how many different races you have won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missable_note: Cal's fishing challenge is a one-time challenge — beat him when it appears.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Take Cal's fishing challenge when it appears.
Beat his score in the challenge — fishing skill and bait choice matter (belum dicek di dalam game).
Win the challenge and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Find an arcade in Leonida.
Play any arcade game to completion.
The trophy pops when the game ends.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missable_note: Andy's final mission only appears in its chapter window.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Work through Andy's mission strand.
His final mission appears late in the strand — finish it.
Do it before the chapter finale closes the strand.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missable_note: Kenton's final mission only appears in its chapter window.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Work through Kenton's mission strand.
Finish his final mission when it appears.
Do it before the chapter finale.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missable_note: Billy's final mission only appears in its chapter window.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Work through Billy's mission strand.
Finish his final mission when it appears.
Do it before the final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — count target 8
guide: Find strangers across Leonida — their markers appear on the map.
Complete 8 full stranger mission strands.
Track completed strands with the counter below.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missable_note: Randy's final mission only appears in its chapter window.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Work through Randy's mission strand.
Finish his final mission when it appears.
Do it before the chapter finale.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missable_note: Tyrone's final mission only appears in its chapter window.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Work through Tyrone's mission strand.
Finish his final mission when it appears.
Do it before the chapter finale.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — count target 18
guide: Find the meditation spots across Leonida — there are 18.
Meditate at each one; the exact spots are belum dicek di dalam game.
Track them with the counter below.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Take Bret's hunting job.
Track and hunt the unique animal he names — its location is belum dicek di dalam game.
Bring it down and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — count target 3
guide: Collect cards across Leonida and complete 3 full sets.
Cards are found in the world and in shops — exact spots are belum dicek di dalam game.
Track completed sets with the counter below.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — count target 100
guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations.
Each location counts once — spread out across Leonida.
Track locations with the counter below.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — count target 50
guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind.
Challenges are listed in the in-game menu — pick the easiest first.
Track them with the counter below.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_note: You need your partner with you when you lose the 4-star wanted level — do it while partner missions are available.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you.
Lose the cops and escape — break line of sight and stay hidden.
The trophy pops once the wanted level clears with your partner present.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missable_note: All 3 robberies must happen back-to-back with your partner, in one wanted-level run.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Bring your partner and rob a shop.
Rob two more shops immediately, back-to-back, without losing your wanted level.
If the wanted level clears between shops, start the chain again.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — count target 100
guide: Drive or enter 100 different vehicles.
New models count — repeats do not.
Track discovered vehicles with the counter below.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Find a group of at least 5 enemies.
Activate Combat Focus and take down 5 of them in that one use.
Busy gang areas are the easiest place to line this up.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missable_note: The unscheduled VCIA departure is a one-time set piece — do it when the opportunity appears.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Go to VCIA airport.
Make an unscheduled departure — steal a plane and take off without clearance (belum dicek di dalam game).
Get airborne and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Get into a Rhino tank.
Survive the heat the tank draws — the exact trigger is belum dicek di dalam game.
The trophy pops once the Rhino sequence is done.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missable_note: One detection ruins the attempt — plan the robbery before you start.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Pick a jewelry store and case it first.
Rob it without being detected — stay quiet and avoid cameras and guards.
If you are spotted, leave and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — count target 5
guide: Rob bank vaults and escape each time — 5 in total.
Each vault needs planning and a getaway route.
Track vaults with the counter below.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missable_note: Armored trucks appear on a schedule — if you miss one, wait for the next (belum dicek di dalam game).
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Find an armored truck on the road.
Stop it, rob it, and escape the police response.
The trophy pops once you escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — count target 52
guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida.
The in-game map shows which areas you have visited.
Track areas with the counter below.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Find illegal operations belonging to each gang.
Rob one operation per gang — the gang count is belum dicek di dalam game.
The trophy pops once every gang's operation has been robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Go to Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail at a beach bar with a view (belum dicek di dalam game).
The trophy pops once the drink is enjoyed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missable_note: The showroom smash is a one-time set piece — do it when the opportunity appears.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Find a vehicle showroom.
Drive a vehicle through the showroom glass and out the other side.
The trophy pops on the smash.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a game of bowling and follow through the full game.
The trophy pops at the end of the game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missable_note: The partnership moment only happens while that partner strand is active.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Build the partnership strand to its big moment.
The exact trigger is belum dicek di dalam game.
The trophy pops on the partnership moment.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
PSNProfiles — count target 500
guide: Make choices across the game — dialogue and mission choices count.
PSN tracks a count to 500; use the counter below.
Keep choosing as you play and the total climbs.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable_note: This is about succeeding on a second try — a failed first attempt is part of it.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Fail an attempt at something, then succeed on the second try.
The exact activity is belum dicek di dalam game — retry-based challenges are the likely spot.
The trophy pops on the successful second attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Explore Leonida's strange corners.
Witness something strange — the exact event is belum dicek di dalam game.
The trophy pops when the strange event happens.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missable_note: A melee drive-by needs a moving vehicle and a target — set it up deliberately.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Get in a vehicle with a melee weapon ready.
Drive past a target and knock them over with the melee attack.
The trophy pops on the drive-by hit.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and jobs.
Launder them through your contacts — $250,000 in total.
Keep laundering as you earn and the trophy pops at $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida.
Weapons, clothes, food and cars all count toward the total.
The trophy pops once spending passes $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Buy every garage property — there are 8.
Garages are listed on the in-game property sites.
The trophy pops when the last garage is bought.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
sources: Official trophy list — Exophase (name, description, grade)
guide: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register 10 vehicles to it.
The trophy pops on the tenth registration.
